name: catchme-monorepo
description: CatchMe — Exception Flow Explorer for Visual Studio Code (monorepo root)

scripts.//build:server: Runs the Maven wrapper from server-java/ (mvnw resolves .mvn/ relative to the cwd, so the cd is required).
scripts.//build:all: Both halves: the TypeScript workspace and the jdt.ls analyzer jar. The Java step needs Maven and is slow on a cold p2 cache.
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run copy:server
scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter catchme run package
